description: Return the UNSIGNED calls a wallet sends to withdraw from a Mamo Account, plus an unwrap back to ETH for the Ethereum Account. Call `preview_withdraw` first, read its warnings out to the person, then pass its `previewId` here. Re-checked live; no calls if one fails. Send atomically with `wallet_sendCalls` where supported, else in order; nothing is signed or broadcast here.

previewId.description: The handle `preview_withdraw` returned. Send it ALONE, or the arguments without it instead — not both (refused). Every check is re-run live either way. Expires in 30 minutes.

name: prepare_withdraw
title: Build the unsigned calls for a withdrawal
